name: Commissioning Equipment & Consumables (Lube Oil,Diesel, Chemical)
description: Printed OEM-approved gas-engine lubricants, viscosity grade and chemical/fluid specifications for commissioning consumables. No consumable prices or quantities for this project were published in the sources read.

specifications.metric: Shell Mysella S5 N 40 / Shell Mysella  — SAE viscosity class (approved engine oil, Series 4000 and 400 gas engines)
specifications.basis: MTU Fluids and Lubricants Specifications A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Tables 5/6/10/12: Shell Mysella S5 N 40 and S3 N 40 listed with SAE viscosity class 40 for generator/marine gas-engine applications; general rule 'Viscosity grade SAE 40 is stipulated for gas engines. Multigrade oils are not permitted.'

specifications.metric: Castrol Duratec L / ExxonMobil Mobil P — SAE viscosity class for listed approved/alternative oils
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Tables 5, 6, 10 and 12: Castrol Duratec L, Mobil Pegasus 705/805/1005 and MTU GEO NG Power X2L all listed at SAE viscosity class 40; some alternative oils noted '* The use of these engine oils shortens the service life.'

specifications.metric: ANTIFREEZE / corrosion inhibitor and A — permissible ethylene-glycol antifreeze concentration
specifications.basis: MTU A001072/02E printed 2020-06, Table 17: ethylene glycol antifreeze min 35% to max 50% by volume, with protection to -20 C / -25 C / -31 C / -37 C at 35/40/45/50%; above 50% impermissible. Section 5.2 of the same document covers 'NOx reducing agent AUS 32 for SCR exhaust gas aftertreatment systems'.

specifications.metric: MAN 175D post-commissioning filter pac — number of standardised spare parts packages
specifications.basis: MAN PrimeServ 'Prepare for MAN 175D' printed June 2022: four packages - post-commissioning (filters for complete replacement after commissioning), mechanical (lube oil/fuel/air filters, gaskets, spare fuel injector), after-treatment (urea filters, injectors, NOx sensors), automation (speed/pressure/float/temperature sensors).

vendor_models.line: Shell Mysella S5 N 40 / Shell Mysella S3 N 40 gas engine oils
Castrol Duratec L / ExxonMobil Mobil Pegasus 705, 805, 1005 / MTU GEO NG Power X2L

gaps.why: No published prices, drum sizes for this site, diesel volume or chemical quantities for commissioning of the 7-unit plant were found. MTU and MAN print specifications only; Shell's product page did not render usable text through WebFetch, so no Shell-page figures are recorded.
gaps.next_action: Obtain priced consumables list and confirm which OEM oil approval applies to the actual engine make.
